gen-gf-mclaren-fs-rowan: Friendly and literary, Rowan opens every curve wide and keeps its thin strokes about half as heavy as the thick ones. McLaren above it stays low and expressive, and it wears you out slowly.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-fs-karma: MedievalSharp stands tall, with short stems above and below its letters. Karma, a trustworthy serif with a calm modulation and terminals well clear of the stem, feels settled and traditional beside that crisp, commanding display.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-fs-paquito: Close-set lowercase and capitals give the body a confident, approachable read beneath the bold display letters of MedievalSharp. Paquito does its best work in quick bursts of text, with extended reading asking more of the eye.
gen-gf-merienda-fs-bespoke-sans: Hand-drawn friendliness, graceful and loose, is what Merienda does best. Bespoke Sans does the sharper, refined work, leaving generous room between curve ends and the stem, which is built for brief spells of reading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: BhuTuka Expanded One is a literary, authoritative serif whose thin joins are no thinner than its stems. And over extended reading, its curvy, unclamped letters slow the pace to a leisurely walk beneath Metamorphous.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads stretched out and bookish, its open counters letting every word breathe with the same stroke throughout. Metamorphous is the one to reach for at display scale.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-kiwi-maru: Generous sidebearings and a high-set midline give Metamorphous a stately stride. Kiwi Maru settles in lower, with terminals stopping far from the stem and generous letterspace, an editorial counterweight to that stately stride.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-padyakke-expanded: Metamorphous stands tall and a little ornate up top, while Padyakke Expanded One spreads out below with pitcher-mouthed curves and a constant pen width. The wide, unhurried body is what you remember.
gen-fs-pencerio-newsreader: A calligraphic hand gives Pencerio its graceful, formal air, with words fitted close and clenched. Newsreader handles the refined, authoritative reading, leaving Pencerio to do its best work in a line or two.
gen-gf-federant-fs-rowan: Commanding Federant leads with just a light touch of stroke modulation, big and bold up top. Rowan takes over with literary warmth, its curves generously open, a serif that feels friendly across a couple of lines.
gen-gf-gaegu-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws every glyph as a ribbon of constant width, with counters that breathe. And Gaegu scribbles in with an inviting marker-like line, charming for a moment but not for lengthy paragraphs.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-space-grotesk: Lakki Reddy writes with hand-drawn looseness, its strokes tapering only slightly, while Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a constant ribbon. Extended reading would feel steady but is comfortable only in modest helpings.
